extracted.name: Slow Cooker Hawaiian Chicken
extracted.description: Just chicken, pineapple, barbeque sauce, soy sauce, and a slow cooker combine for this delicious chicken dish that will leave your kitchen smelling great.
instruction_lines: Put chicken breasts into the crock of a slow cooker; top with barbeque sauce, pineapple slices, and soy sauce.
Cook on High for 4 to 5 hours.
